name: renpak
description: AVIF compression for Ren'Py visual novel archives — typically 4–5× smaller on image data, without forking the engine. Hooks Ren'Py's standard `file_open_callback`, so the game decodes AVIF transparently at runtime. Tested on Eternum (Caribdis): 11.3 → 7.2 GiB on disk, 4.73× on the image bytes themselves.

name: shulker
description: TUI for a friend-group Minecraft (Paper/Purpur) server: whitelist, ops, world switching, config editing, backups, chunk pre-gen, and SakuraFrp tunnel control.

name: tokmato
description: Personal token-economy pomodoro app. Focus and health behaviors earn auditable tokens; tokens recharge a shared time pool used for entertainment, snacks, and wishlist redemption. Includes multi-device sync, Web Push, and an Android relay for high-priority FCM reminders.

name: pikpak-kotlin
description: A Kotlin Multiplatform SDK for PikPak cloud storage. Handles session persistence, captcha auth, rate limiting, and resumable uploads. Extracted from the Animeko PikPak work.

name: writing-style
description: Agent skill for prose style checks: register matching, no translation smell, no marketing voice, and no AI-essay phrasing in Chinese and English.

name: csync
description: Chrome extension that syncs cookies and localStorage from normal windows to incognito for configured sites.

name: DeepSeek-Structured-Output-for-LangChain
description: Small compatibility patch for using structured output with DeepSeek models through LangChain's ChatOpenAI interface.
